entry.author: Eastern Institute Of Technology
entry.summary:
From classroom learning to thriving careers, EIT accounting graduates making their mark at BDO Gisborne.

We’re proud to share this kōrero featuring Kylee Potae, Advisory Director and Managing Partner at BDO Gisborne, alongside EIT Bachelor of Accounting graduates Ashleigh Harding and Katelyn Grimson.

In this video, Kylee talks about why BDO loves welcoming EIT graduates into their team, because of ‘their vibrant, their young, their energetic, they’ve got great skills and they bring a good positive energy’. Katelyn gives us a glimpse into her day to day mahi preparing financial accounts and supporting clients, while Ashleigh reflects on the incredible study support, she received from BDO as she completed both her EIT degree and the Chartered Accountancy Programme.

Their journeys show just how far a qualification in accounting can take you, from hands on learning at EIT to meaningful work in a supportive, future focused firm.

If you’re someone who loves problem solving, numbers, and helping people succeed, this pathway could be your next big step.
